definitions.gloss: ardent desire; fervent wish; burning aspiration
definitions.explanation: An intense, passionate desire for something. Stronger than {希望|きぼう} (hope) or {願望|がんぼう} (wish), conveying urgency and emotional intensity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熱望|ねつぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続編|ぞくへん}→続編：13818_zokuhen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熱望|ねつぼう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fans are eagerly hoping for a sequel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{熱望|ねつぼう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The study abroad that I had fervently wished for over many years finally came true.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat, passion) + {望|ぼう} (hope, desire). Conveys an intense, burning desire — much stronger than ordinary wanting.

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Common in news, essays, and written narrative. Rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {熱望|ねつぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ardently desire
- {熱望|ねつぼう}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: to be eagerly awaited
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱望|ねつぼう}: long-held ardent wish

SIMILAR WORDS (intensity scale):
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧: hope, wish (neutral)
- ⟦{願望|がんぼう}→願望：05085_ganbou⟧: desire, aspiration (stronger)
- ⟦{渇望|かつぼう}→渇望：05999_katsubou⟧: craving, yearning (desperate)
- {熱望|ねつぼう}: fervent desire (passionate, burning)
